checks.subject: Authentic standard external application binding
checks.conclusion: Three random in-memory wallet seeds and application keys produce distinct real standard SPKs, accounts and mailboxes. Public Wallet::open uses real SQLite, fallback_spk, onchain=None and no daemon. Regtest signatures and actual server-stored immutable binding are checked; reopening requires the original database.

checks.subject: Authentic normal current financial cut
checks.conclusion: Three completed normal sends hydrate real signed recipient bodies and keys. Actual consumed source plus three fully signed successor branches are compared to an attested ordinary-spend proof and server-stored bodies. Source and successor path geometry, signature validation, value, anchor and expiry are checked. Default split factor2 remains; final four sender leaves plus three recipient leaves sum to the real100k board.

checks.subject: Independent script boundary and one fee per output
checks.conclusion: Expected dust values are asserted against each actual Script::minimal_non_dust. Distinct SPKs prevent regrouping the three boundary accounts. Whole sub-dust gross is forfeited with fee0 and no payout mapping; exact/+1 pay dust/dust+1 with1000 each. Sender leaves sort by ID as settlement::allocate does and split only one1000 fee. Current leaf amounts and whole100k policy conservation are explicit.

checks.subject: Native canonical financial attribution
checks.conclusion: Actual active customer rows bind gross/fee/payout/forfeit/script/mailbox/user key to stored signed parent bytes and canonical >=6-confirmed block/hash. LEFT JOIN retains the no-output dust leaf; paying fields and null payout association are checked. Parent must spend a real signed lineage point via its exact expiry clause, have zero actual miner fee, and have one actual same-block P2A child with positive recomputed prevout fee, >=6 confirmations and exact stored bytes/fee/hash.

checks.subject: Whole public-chain cut and duplicates
checks.conclusion: Every canonical transaction after the pre-expiry scan boundary is inspected for registered payees before selected-cut filtering. Exactly one unspent output per paying account and none for the forfeited account are required, including global mempool negatives. Block-order graph closure rejects outside input subsidies and repeated selected inputs; exact root+two confirmed100k sponsors conserve selected300k into actual positive terminal Core UTXOs and actual graph fees. Parent/child membership, current watch-wallet terminal ownership and all-generation current-ID/old-ancestor allocation exclusions are checked.

checks.subject: Returning original balances and history
checks.conclusion: Original SDK databases return only after canonical chain assertions. Each receipt binds exact per-leaf value and shared output, confirmed parent/block, disposition and local Spent/full-body state. All ten balance buckets are zero, no unilateral exits or pending sends remain, ordinary movement bodies are unchanged, one grouped fallback movement consumes exactly the known current IDs and gross once, and destination/fee/forfeit metadata is exact. Repeated sync and a later rebuilt-tip close/reopen preserve complete results and financial cut.

checks.subject: Public evidence chronology and private-material exclusion
checks.conclusion: Typed capsule is written only after chain/financial oracles with overall_pass=false; COMPLETE/true is written only after repeated returning-SDK and reopen oracles. Fields are public scripts, pubkeys/xpubs, mailbox identifiers, signed VTXOs, public transaction bytes/outpoints, amounts and movement IDs. Application seeds/private keys, SQLite, config, wallet material and raw logs are not serialized. Signed VTXO encoding is public recovery data, not a private signing key.
